notes:
{学生|がくせい} means student, typically referring to someone attending school from elementary through university.

STUDENT TYPES BY LEVEL:
- ⟦{小学生|しょうがくせい}→小学生：03069_shougakusei⟧: elementary school student
- ⟦{中学生|ちゅうがくせい}→中学生：10973_chuugakusei⟧: junior high school student
- ⟦{高校生|こうこうせい}→高校生：01580_koukousei⟧: high school student
- ⟦{大学生|だいがくせい}→大学生：01653_daigakusei⟧: university student
- ⟦{留学生|りゅうがくせい}→留学生：02986_ryuugakusei⟧: international student

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {学生|がくせい}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧: student days
- ⟦{学生|がくせい}{証|しょう}→学生証：14966_gakuseishou⟧: student ID
- {学生|がくせい}⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧: student discount

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧: pupil (more common for elementary/junior high)
- ⟦{児童|じどう}→児童：03340_jidou⟧: child (formal, used in education contexts)
